name: Network / Environment Issues
description: Connectivity issues: DNS, timeout, connection refused, or Cloudflare block. Action: Re-run. If persistent, check VPN/DNS/Cloudflare credentials.

name: Browser / Infrastructure Crash
description: Browser, page, or context crashed unexpectedly. Action: Re-run. If persistent, check system resources or browser version.
messageRegex: (?s).*(?:Target page, context or browser has been closed|Target closed|Context closed|browserType\.launch).*

name: Preprod Data Unavailable
description: No films, showtimes, D-BOX sessions, or seats available in the environment. This is a data/scheduling issue, not a code defect. Action: Verify content exists for the test cinema and date.
messageRegex: (?s).*(?:No D-BOX showtimes|No D-BOX films|No suitable seats found|No .* found on the cinema|No films found|No films available|No showtimes available|Unable to find a film|Failed across \d+ day|HOY: No films).*

name: Feature Not Available in Environment
description: Feature/page does not exist in this environment (e.g., Bonos removed in lab). Action: Tag with @broken-prod or skip for this environment.

name: Payment Provider Failure
description: Redsys 3DS simulator or payment gateway did not respond in time. This is an external dependency issue. Action: Re-run. If persistent, check Redsys simulator availability.

name: Booking Verification Failed
description: Post-payment verification failed: confirmation page did not load, or the ticket URL pattern was unexpected. Action: Check if the booking completed and review the trace.
messageRegex: (?s).*(?:Booking confirmation did not become visible|Living ticket URL did not match|review-ticket pattern|booking.*confirmation.*timeout).*

name: Ticket Type Mapping Mismatch
description: A ticket type name from the site (e.g., 'Adulto') doesn't match configured patterns. Action: Update ticket type mappings in test data if the site changed labels.
messageRegex: (?s).*(?:is not a valid ticket type pattern|not included in the mappings|ticketTypeName).*

name: Seat Selection State Error
description: Seat picker state assertion failed: a seat was not in the expected state (selected/available/deselected). This may indicate a preprod UI timing issue.

name: Known Limitations
description: Feature with known issues or environment-specific restrictions. Tracked and expected to fail until resolved.

name: Navigation / Page Load Timeout
description: page.goto, page.goBack, or waitForLoadState exceeded timeout. The page was too slow to load. Action: Check environment performance and review trace.

name: DOM State Error
description: Element detached from DOM or not stable during interaction — a timing/race condition. Action: Add waits or stabilize the selector.
messageRegex: (?s).*(?:not attached to the DOM|detached from DOM|Element is no longer attached|waiting for element to be stable).*

name: Blocking Modal Interrupted Flow
description: An unexpected popup/modal blocked the test flow. Action: Check for new promotional modals. May need updated dismiss handler.

name: Cloudflare Challenge Block
description: Cloudflare WAF blocked the browser with a security challenge page. The test never reached the actual site. Action: Regenerate storage state (npx playwright test --project=setup) or use --headed --workers=1.
messageRegex: (?s).*(?:Cloudflare challenge detected|Verificación de seguridad en curso|Checking your browser before accessing|Just a moment).*

name: Full Test Timeout
description: Entire test exceeded max time (90-180s). Severe blocker: page never loaded or flow was stuck. Action: Review trace for where it stalled.

name: Element Interaction Timeout
description: A specific UI action (click, fill, waitFor) timed out. Element did not appear or become interactive. Action: Review screenshot/trace for layout changes or loading spinners.

name: Selector Mismatch
description: CSS/XPath selector matched multiple elements (strict mode violation). Action: Update selector in *.selectors.ts to be more specific.

name: Assertion Failure
description: An expect() assertion failed with an unexpected value. Not a timeout or infrastructure issue. Action: Review error details and trace.
